added_failures_note: Unmeasured: source manifest.md baseline_suite and after_suite are empty; no baseline/head suite logs exist to derive a failure delta. The successful artifact-only gate is not a suite pair.

failure_conditions: Row-set and seven-row assertions fail on missing, duplicated or unexpected tokens.
Worklist digest and source/evidence equalities fail on altered inputs, omitted bindings or documentation mismatches against the independent worklist.
Registry membership assertions fail if a claimed reused token is absent; replay assertions fail on parser admission/refusal, IR, composition or revision mismatches.

Independent literal corrected-name, selector OR, sample-domain and source-unit assertions fail if current_density, vertical_grid or vertical_position_of_magnetic_field_line is reinstated as a complete identity.
Token-set and registration-state assertions fail on missing, inconsistent or premature registration of the five proposed definitions.
DD receipt digest, independent literal A paths and known ip control fail if captured evidence is changed or lacks the confirmed units.
HTML content and unique-anchor assertions fail on missing corrected names, bindings, unit evidence or duplicated anchors.
Changed-path and stable-main-head assertions fail on out-of-scope artifacts or concurrent grammar-revision drift.
assertion_review.reason: All three committed files are JSON or HTML evidence; no test, function, class or module is added.
assertion_review.same_input_comparisons: compose(parse(name).ir) == name checks round-trip behavior, not semantic identity; returning a different canonical name or malformed IR would fail it, while changing the input name with its receipt would not prove the intended identity. Durability here relies instead on the separate literal-name and independent worklist assertions; no committed tautological assertion is added.
